summary: Iter47 (Deep Linking + Push Tokens) backend testing — 17/17 NEW iter47 tests PASS plus full smoke regression. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter47_deeplink_push.py covering: (a) AASA + assetlinks.json structure/content-type via BACKEND DIRECT (localhost:8001) — all 4 PASS; (b) POST /api/register-push happy path for android/ios/web — all return 201 with status='pending_deploy' as designed while EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder (upstream 401 handled gracefully, backend does NOT crash); (c) Pydantic 422 validation on user_id empty/missing, invalid platform, short device_token, missing device_token — all 5 parametrized cases PASS; (d) Idempotent upsert into db.push_registrations (2 calls same user_id → 1 doc) PASS; (e) Audit doc stores token_fingerprint (first 8 chars + '...') NOT the full token — PASS; (f) Smoke regression: GET /api/ 200, admin login 200 with JWT, GET /api/public/retas/buscar 200. INFRA_NOTE: .well-known/* paths via the public preview URL hit the Expo SPA (frontend on :3000) because the K8s ingress only forwards /api/* to backend — those 2 tests SKIP with a flag. Backend code is correct; production padelappretas.app DNS/ingress must route /.well-known/* to the backend container for Universal/App Links to validate on devices. Iter45 regression: 16/16 PASS. Iter46 regression: 12/17 PASS — 5 ERROR (event loop binding in motor client across per-test new loops) are a PRE-EXISTING infrastructure flake unrelated to iter47 changes; applied small `run()` helper hardening that recovered 2 of them.

minor.issue: Backend serves both correctly with 200 + Content-Type application/json on direct hit (localhost:8001), but the K8s preview ingress only forwards /api/* to the backend. Via the public preview URL these paths return the Expo SPA HTML. PRODUCTION padelappretas.app DNS/ingress MUST route /.well-known/* to the backend container, otherwise Apple's CDN fetch (for Universal Links) and Android's autoVerify (App Links) will fail. Also: AASA appIDs still contain placeholder TEAM_ID_TODO and assetlinks has SHA256_FINGERPRINT_TODO_REPLACE_AFTER_BUILD — must be replaced before App Store / Play Store submission.

Behavior CORRECT (returns 201 status='pending_deploy' when EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder). Reminder: Once deployer injects real key, the same path will return status='registered' — frontend should accept both as success.

action_items: PRODUCTION ingress for padelappretas.app: configure DNS/reverse-proxy to route /.well-known/apple-app-site-association and /.well-known/assetlinks.json to backend container (currently only /api/* is routed). Without this, iOS Universal Links and Android App Links won't validate on real devices.

Replace placeholders in /app/backend/routers/wellknown.py before app store submission: IOS_TEAM_ID='TEAM_ID_TODO' → real Apple Developer Team ID; ANDROID_SHA256_FINGERPRINTS=[...'SHA256_FINGERPRINT_TODO_REPLACE_AFTER_BUILD'] → real keystore SHA-256 fingerprints from EAS/Play Console.

(Optional follow-up, pre-existing) Migrate iter46 tests off `asyncio.get_event_loop()` and the per-test `event_loop` fixture to either pytest-asyncio properly installed or per-fixture `asyncio.new_event_loop()` + `asyncio.set_event_loop()` to fix the 5 motor-client/event-loop-bind ERRORs. Not blocking iter47 — these errors do NOT touch the iter47 code paths.
critical_code_review_comments: push_router.py and push_service.py are well structured: lazy httpx client singleton, idempotent upsert with token_fingerprint only (no PII risk), graceful 401→pending_deploy mapping, 5xx→502 to client, RequestError→502. No business logic concerns.
wellknown.py is correct (no /api prefix, application/json media_type, structure matches Apple/Google specs). Note hardcoded placeholders are intentional and clearly TODO-marked.
Server.py mounts wellknown_router on `app` (not on `api`) — correct. Push router mounted on `api` prefix — correct (POST /api/register-push).

Frontend files referenced in PRD (usePushRegistration.ts, WaitlistPushPrompt.tsx, deepLinkStore.ts) NOT validated end-to-end — requires native build per the agent-to-agent context note (web preview cannot simulate OS-level Universal Link intent handling).

Pre-existing iter46 flake: `run()` helper used `asyncio.get_event_loop()` which raises in Python 3.11+; partially patched (2 tests recovered). Full fix would require fixture lifecycle redesign — out of scope for iter47 testing.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter46_acid_refund_overflow.py (minor — hardened `run()` helper to recover from missing/closed event loop on Python 3.11+)

rca_of_issue: Two infra observations (not bugs in iter47 code): (1) Preview K8s ingress does not route /.well-known/* to backend — production ingress at padelappretas.app must route those paths to the backend container. (2) AASA + assetlinks contain TEAM_ID/SHA-256 placeholders that must be replaced before submitting to App Store/Play Store. Iter46 5-error pre-existing flake (motor client bound to closed loop) is documented but not a regression introduced by iter47.
